render_capsule: render a 3D capsule shape at a given transformation matrix with configurable length, radius, color, and slice count
render_cylinder: render a 3D cylinder at a given transformation matrix with configurable length, radius, color, and slice count
render_transform: render a 3D transformation matrix as colored axis arrows or lines showing position and orientation
render_ground: render a 2D grid ground plane on a specified axis with configurable size, color, and origin indicator
render_matrix: render a numpy matrix as a 2D color-coded heatmap with configurable value range and color mapping
